Confirm responsibility and follow-up Mimi first confirms who is responsible for the area and who has authority to approve a change. If there is no decision, Mimi reports the status and follows the local referral process. She does not promise approval, repairs or savings, and does not implement a new checklist yet. Agree on the next conversation, without promising an outcome.
